name: ViAdminShift
description: ViAdminShift is a Vietnamese benchmark built from the administrative reform in force from 1 July 2025 (63 provinces merged into 34, districts abolished, 10,035 communes reorganized into 3,321). It contains the benchmark items (data version 2025-07-01), retrieval contexts, probing sets with the exact prompts, the model outputs behind every reported result, annotation sheets, scorers and analysis code. Data, outputs and annotations are CC BY-SA 4.0 (tiny-aya-global outputs CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); code is MIT.
